candidates.change_summary: Replace the conditional so that the pot is always paid out on every play (remove randomness check), causing pot to be set to 0 each successful play.
Invert the randomness check so payout happens when random != 0 (previously when random == 0), altering when pot is cleared.
After winning, set pot to FEE_AMOUNT instead of 0, leaving a residual pot value after payout.
Move pot reset before transfers on win: set pot = 0 before paying, changing the value transferred and final pot.
On win, subtract only FEE_AMOUNT from pot but do not reset pot to 0 (remove pot = 0), so pot retains remainder.
Change the required ticket amount check from equality to inequality, allowing any value except the ticket amount and thus altering pot updates and payouts.
Change the random condition to trigger on random == 1 instead of 0, flipping when payouts occur.
Transfer fee to msg.sender instead of bank, changing balances and observable outcomes after play.
Omit resetting the pot to zero after a win, so pot retains value and affects future plays.
Add an extra increment to pot in the payout branch so pot increases more before payout and affects amount sent.
